routes.name: ASAN eVisa
routes.summary: Apply online through ASAN Visa. The e-visa is issued within 3 working days and lets you stay up to 30 days. An urgent option gets it done within 3 hours. Only nationals of listed countries can use it.

other: Only for nationals of countries on the official eligible list. The list is on evisa.gov.az, which blocked the browser, so check it before applying.

sources.label: State Migration Service: visas and ASAN Visa

routes.processing: 3 working days, or 3 hours with the urgent option.

routes.name: Work Permit and Temporary Residence
routes.summary: Your employer applies for the permit, and only if no qualified Azerbaijani can fill the job. Issued for 1 year or the contract term if shorter, extendable by up to 1 year each time. A temporary residence permit is also needed.

other: Must be 18 or older and able to work.

No work permit needed for many groups, for example permanent residents, people married to an Azerbaijani citizen, business founders who own at least 51 percent, highly skilled migrants, university lecturers and IDP or asylum holders.
If the permit ends and you have no other basis to stay, you must leave within 10 working days.
The fee amount is not stated on the page.

stay.note: Issued for one year or the contract term if shorter. Each extension is up to one year.

routes.name: Temporary Residence Permit
routes.summary: Issued on set grounds such as close family of a citizen, a work permit, full-time study, entrepreneurship, being a highly skilled specialist, or investment. Valid up to 1 year and extendable.

other: Grounds include: family of an Azerbaijani citizen, work permit, full-time study, running a business, branch or company head, highly qualified specialist or highly skilled migrant.
Real estate worth at least AZN 100,000, a fixed-term bank deposit of at least AZN 100,000, or government securities of at least AZN 100,000 can be a ground.
Investment of at least AZN 500,000 in the economy can be a ground.
Needs proof of housing, a health certificate (HIV, hepatitis B and C) and registration at your address if you stay more than 15 days.
The fee amount is not stated on the page.

sources.label: State Migration Service: temporary and permanent residence

stay.note: First permit up to 1 year, extendable by up to 2 years each time. Highly skilled migrants can get up to 3 years, extendable by up to 3 years. Apply at least 30 days before expiry.

documents: Passport valid more than 3 months past the permit

routes.name: Investor Residence
routes.summary: Temporary residence for investors and property owners. AZN 500,000 invested in the economy, or AZN 100,000 in real estate, a bank term deposit or state securities, qualifies. Permanent residence needs AZN 500,000, or AZN 200,000 in property, a deposit or securities.

investment.note: AZN 500,000 invested in the economy. Alternatively AZN 100,000 in real estate, a fixed-term bank deposit, or government securities for temporary residence. For permanent residence the lower options are AZN 200,000.

sources.label: State Migration Service: temporary and permanent residence

routes.name: Permanent Residence Permit
routes.summary: Needs at least 2 years on temporary residence on most grounds. Valid 5 years, renewable with no limit. You pass a test on Azerbaijani laws and the language unless exempt.

eligibility.language: Test on Azerbaijani laws and the official language, unless exempt
other: Grounds include: parent, spouse, child or sibling who is an Azerbaijani citizen; AZN 500,000 investment; real estate, bank term deposit or state securities worth AZN 200,000; highly skilled specialist; family of a permanent resident; company head or business owner.
Exempt from the test: highly skilled migrants, under 18, age 65 and over, 81 to 100 percent disability.
Proof of sufficient funds, with exceptions for family of a citizen and highly skilled migrants.
Time away over 90 days in a 180 day period breaks continuity.
Apply at least 3 months before your temporary permit expires. The fee amount is not stated on the page.

sources.label: State Migration Service: temporary and permanent residence

stay.note: Extend for 5 more years, apply at least 3 months before expiry. No limit on extensions.

routes.name: Visa-free entry
routes.summary: Citizens of Belarus, Georgia, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Moldova, Uzbekistan, Russia, Tajikistan, Ukraine and Turkey can stay 90 days without a visa. Qatar gets 30 days.

other: Qataris who come to study or work need a visa in advance.
Register at your address if you stay more than 15 days.
The page notes that diplomatic and service passport lists are separate.

stay.note: Qatar: 30 days. Russia: 90 days within one calendar year.

sources.label: State Migration Service: visas and visa-free list

routes.name: Visa on arrival at airports
routes.summary: Citizens of Qatar, Oman, Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, Kuwait, Japan, Indonesia, Iran, China, South Korea, Malaysia, Singapore, Israel and the UAE can get a visa at international airports, valid 30 days (60 for Singapore).

other: US citizens can get a 30 day visa only if flying New York to Baku.
UAE residence visa holders can also get a visa at the airport.

sources.label: State Migration Service: visas at airports

routes.name: Transit visa
routes.summary: Single or two-entry transit visa, valid 30 days, with up to 5 days in the country. Issued based on your route and travel time.

routes.name: Citizenship by naturalization
routes.summary: Foreigners who have lived legally in Azerbaijan for the last 5 years without a break, with legal income and proof of the state language, can apply. Time counts from the day permanent residence was granted. The President signs the decision.

eligibility.language: Proof of Azerbaijani state language knowledge, with a Ministry of Education reference
other: Legal source of income, or a sponsoring citizen.
Pledge to follow the Constitution and laws.
Shorter paths exist for stateless people and people with high achievements in science, technology, culture or sports.

citizenship.note: Dual citizenship rules were not on the page read.
